run.platform: Web, Microsoft Edge (Chromium, headless, not capped at 60 Hz), 390x844 @2x, WebGL 2, test machine only
run.access_mode: Playwright (scripts/perf.mjs) running the game's own autoplay benchmark (#perfbench_N), with no other browsers running
run.scope: Boot time (3 runs), gameplay frame rate (3 x 60 s), 4x CPU throttle (60 s), memory over a 200 s session
run.summary: All budgets met on the test machine: boot 3.1 s (2.5 s of it is the designed loading screen), 1% low 90-119 fps, 58 fps at 4x CPU throttle, 1-3 hitches per minute, heap growth 0.95 MB/min (just under the 1 MB/min budget; worth a 10-minute run on a phone).

coverage.notes: 3096 / 3096 / 3101 ms to the main menu; the loading screen has a ~2.5 s minimum by design.
Budget: 1% low >= 45 fps, <= 2 hitches/min, in at least 2 of 3 runs. Run 1 had 3 hitches/min (2 long tasks), runs 2-3 had 1/min. Averages of ~143 fps reflect the uncapped headless browser.
Heap 8.3 -> 13.2 MB in 200 s (0.95 MB/min, budget 1); DOM stable (-0.4 nodes/min); scene objects +30/min. Close to the budget: repeat with the game's 10-minute benchmark on a real phone.
Real phones (low-end Android, iPhone) need a manual run; numbers here come from a desktop machine.
